Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q3 2021 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of IBM.
Operating income reached $8.9 billion, demonstrating the operating leverage in our model.
Revenue guidance of $3.3 billion assumes no further deterioration in consumer spending trends.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q3 2021.
We delivered record revenue of $3.3 billion this quarter, representing 11% year-over-year growth.
Our outlook assumes current foreign exchange rates hold; currency fluctuations could materially affect results.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
Could you quantify the FX headwind embedded in your guidance?
Thank you for the question. Our cloud segment grew 11% year-over-year, driven by strong enterprise demand.
Second question - Analyst:
How should we think about the cadence of revenue recognition in the second half?
We anticipate margins may be impacted by approximately 43 basis points pending supplier contract renewals.
